newsitem.title: CHINA: REFRIGERATOR CLEARED FOR RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: REFRIGERATOR CLEARED FOR RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor Co Ltd have approved the company's plan for a three-for-10 rights issue based on 1996-end shares outstanding, the company said on Monday.
The rights issue was temporarily priced at 3.2 to 4.8 yuan per share, the company said in a statement in the Shanghai Securities News.

Proceeds from the rights issue would fund a new project with annual production capacity of 400,000 air-conditioner compressors and 100,000 to 200,000 air-conditioners as well as a refrigerator compressor project with annual output of one million, it said.
